# XLSX test fixture

`protected-workbook.xlsx` is generated by `create-fixture.mjs` from XML strings
stored in this directory. It contains:

- `xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml` with one `sheetProtection` element;
- `xl/workbook.xml` with one `workbookProtection` element;
- workbook relationships mapping the protected worksheet to the name `Budget`;
- an unprotected `Notes` worksheet used to check that unrelated content is
  retained.

The workbook contains only synthetic text written for this test suite.
